controles.affirmation: Sept fabricants HVAC dont Lennox sont defendeurs dans une action de groupe consolidee devant un tribunal federal du Michigan alleguant une entente sur les prix de 2020 a aujourd'hui ; plaintes amendees deposees en juillet 2026 ; Lennox ne peut estimer la perte possible et reconnait un impact materiel possible
controles.verbatim_source: "On March 20, 2026, seven HVAC equipment manufacturers (and certain of their affiliated companies), including the Company, were named as defendants in a complaint filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan on behalf of a putative class that alleges violations of Section 1 of the Sherman Antitrust Act of 1890, as amended, and certain state laws. (...) The cases were consolidated under the caption In re HVAC Equipment Antitrust Litigation, No. 2:26-cv-10949 (E.D. Mich.). On July 10, 2026, the plaintiffs filed three amended, consolidated class-action complaints." ; "The alleged class is defined as including all persons who purchased HVAC equipment in the U.S. during the period from January 1, 2020 to the present" ; "the Company cannot reasonably estimate the range of possible loss, if any, or the timing, outcome, or consequence of this litigation. An adverse outcome in this litigation could have a material adverse impact on the Company's business, financial position, results of operations, or cash flows." (10-Q T2 2026, Note 4 et Part II Item 1)

controles.affirmation: "Le segment Residentiel recule depuis CINQ trimestres" / "le declin dure depuis le T1 2025"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2025 : "Net sales increased 7% in the first quarter of 2025 as compared to the same period in 2024 due to favorable price and mix." ; 10-Q T2 2025 : "Net sales increased 3% in the second quarter of 2025 as compared to the same period in 2024" ; 10-Q T3 2025 : "Net sales decreased 12% in the third quarter of 2025 as compared to the same period in 2024" ; 10-K FY2025 (Home Comfort Solutions) : "Net sales decreased 7% in 2025 compared to 2024" ; 10-Q T1 2026 : "Net sales decreased 10% in the first quarter of 2026" ; 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net sales decreased 7% in the second quarter of 2026"
controles.correction_proposee: Le Residentiel a PROGRESSE au T1 2025 (+7%) et au T2 2025 (+3%). Le repli commence au T3 2025 : quatre trimestres consecutifs de baisse (T3 2025, T4 2025, T1 2026, T2 2026), pas cinq, et depuis le T3 2025, pas le T1 2025.

controles.affirmation: "La dette nette a bondi de 85% en un an" (titre et resume) pour atteindre 1,511 Md$ au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Total debt $ 1,581.3" ; "Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash, end of period $ 70.3" (soit 1 511,0 M$ de dette nette). 10-Q T2 2025 : "Total debt $ 1,181.1" ; "Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash, end of period $ 49.2" (soit 1 131,9 M$ de dette nette au 30 juin 2025).
controles.correction_proposee: La dette nette est passee de 1 131,9 M$ au 30/06/2025 a 1 511,0 M$ au 30/06/2026, soit +33,5% sur un an (et +13,1% depuis le 31/12/2025, ou elle etait de 1 335,7 M$). Le chiffre de 1 511 M$ est exact ; le +85% ne se reconcilie avec aucune base du 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: "un levier dette nette/EBITDA qui passe de 0,70x a 1,30x" en un an, source 10-Q T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-Q T2 2026 ne publie aucun ratio dette nette/EBITDA. La seule mesure de levier donnee est : "Our debt-to-total-capital ratio increased to 55% at June 30, 2026, as compared to 54% at December 31, 2025."
controles.correction_proposee: Ratio non publie par la societe. Recalcule : EBITDA glissant ~1 155 M$ (resultat operationnel FY2025 1 041,5 M$ + D&A 112,5 M$) donne ~1,3x au 30/06/2026 mais ~0,98x au 30/06/2025 (dette nette 1 131,9 M$). Le 0,70x correspond a la situation de fin 2024, pas a "un an plus tot". Soit citer explicitement la base de calcul, soit remplacer par le ratio publie (dette/capitaux employes 55% contre 54%).

controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "as of December 31, 2025, approximately 26% of our core workforce locations were unionized"
